name: Genome assembly from short reads (SPAdes and QUAST)
description: Put Illumina reads of a microbial genome together without a reference, then measure how good the assembly is.
details: Use this to assemble the genome of a cultured organism such as a bacterium, a virus or a small fungus from Illumina reads. SPAdes builds contigs (and scaffolds) from one file of reads or a pair of files, set up here for a single cultured organism sequenced deeply; for a mixture of organisms or a single cell, change "Kind of sample" in the SPAdes step. QUAST then reports how many contigs there are, how long they are (N50), the total size and the share of G and C. If you also give a reference genome of a close relative, QUAST says how much of it the assembly covers and how many misassemblies it finds. Reads are used as they are, because SPAdes corrects read errors itself; trim adapters first if your data still has them. SPAdes needs a few gigabytes of memory, and the limit is set in its step (8 GB by default). For long reads use "Genome assembly from long reads (Flye and QUAST)".

inputs.label: Reads, first of the pair
inputs.hint: The FASTQ file of reads, or the first file of a pair, plain or compressed.

inputs.label: Reads, second of the pair (optional)
inputs.hint: The second file of a pair. Leave empty for single-end reads.

inputs.label: Reference genome (optional)
inputs.hint: A genome of the same or a close species as FASTA. QUAST compares the assembly with it. Leave empty to judge the assembly on its own.

outputs.label: Scaffolds
outputs.hint: FASTA with contigs joined where the read pairs allow it.

outputs.label: Assembly graph
outputs.hint: GFA file; open it in Bandage to see how the contigs connect.

outputs.label: Quality summary
outputs.hint: Text with the number of contigs, N50 and total length.

outputs.label: Quality table
outputs.hint: The same numbers as a table.

references.label: Prjibelski A, Antipov D, Meleshko D, Lapidus A, Korobeynikov A. Using SPAdes de novo assembler. Current Protocols in Bioinformatics 2020;70:e102.
Gurevich A, Saveliev V, Vyahhi N, Tesler G. QUAST: quality assessment tool for genome assemblies. Bioinformatics 2013;29:1072-1075.
